name: Wizlo Bearingshiner
summary: At Whitereach Post, Wizlo Bearingshiner waits for help after centaur attacked his caravan. The goblin tinkerer survived alone, while his clients still await their wares. He asks travelers to recover a valuable Hypercapacitor Gizmo from the wreckage.

sections.title: An Engineer at the Post
sections.body: Wizlo Bearingshiner waits with the tauren at Whitereach Post, along the canyon road. Centaur attacked his caravan and left him as its only survivor. His clients still await their wares, and he fears he will not deliver them in time.

sections.title: A Stranded Shipment
sections.body: Wizlo's best gizmo hangs around the neck of a fierce panther caged beside his ruined caravan, north of Whitereach Post. Even the centaur avoid the beast. Wizlo offers travelers the cage key and a reward for recovering the hypercapacitor. He does not know what the device does.

faq.answer: Wizlo Bearingshiner, a goblin tinkerer, waits at Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles after centaur attacked his caravan. He seeks help recovering a Hypercapacitor Gizmo from a caged panther.

faq.q: Where can I find Wizlo Bearingshiner?
faq.answer: You can find Wizlo Bearingshiner at Whitereach Post, a Horde camp along the road near Camp E'thok in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: What kind of experiments does he run?
faq.answer: Wizlo is trying to recover his Hypercapacitor Gizmo. He does not know what it does, so its exact function is unknown.

faq.q: Why is a goblin working with the Horde at Whitereach Post?
faq.answer: Wizlo did not mean to stop at Whitereach Post. Centaur attacked his caravan nearby, leaving him stranded while his clients await their shipments.

faq.q: Does Wizlo belong to the Steamwheedle Cartel?
faq.answer: No Steamwheedle affiliation is established for Wizlo. At Whitereach Post with the Horde, he is focused on recovering his goods and delivering them to his clients.
The Hypercapacitor Gizmo is a valuable device around the neck of a caged panther beside Wizlo's wrecked caravan. Even Wizlo does not know its purpose.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may understand Wizlo's wish to recover the mysterious Hypercapacitor Gizmo and learn what it does.
At Whitereach Post, you can make camp alongside the local tauren and draw on Wizlo's mechanical expertise to secure useful gadgets.
